B.replacement: 回头客=有购买，不检查至少两笔订单
B.replacement_sql:
WITH cust_orders AS (
  SELECT CustomerKey, countDistinct(SalesOrderNumber) AS n_orders
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
  GROUP BY CustomerKey
)
SELECT pc.ProductCategoryName AS category,
       (sumIf(f.SalesAmount, co.n_orders >= 1) * 100.0 / nullif(sum(f.SalesAmount), 0)) AS pct_repeat_customer_sales
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
JOIN cust_orders co ON f.CustomerKey = co.CustomerKey
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ProductKey,toNullable(ProductName) AS ProductName,ProductSubcategoryKey,BrandName,ColorName,AvailableForSaleDate FROM retail.DimProduct) p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ProductSubcategoryKey,toNullable(ProductSubcategoryName) AS ProductSubcategoryName,ProductCategoryKey FROM retail.DimProductSubcategory) psc ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = psc.ProductSubcategoryKey
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ProductCategoryKey,toNullable(ProductCategoryName) AS ProductCategoryName FROM retail.DimProductCategory) pc ON psc.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY sumIf(f.SalesAmount, co.n_orders >= 1) * 100.0 / nullif(sum(f.SalesAmount), 0) DESC

B.replacement: 首购年份分群=该年有购买，客户可以进入多个年份
B.replacement_sql:
WITH first_purchase AS (
  SELECT CustomerKey, toYear(DateKey) AS cohort_year
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
  GROUP BY CustomerKey,cohort_year
),
customer_spend AS (
  SELECT CustomerKey, SUM(SalesAmount) AS lifetime_spend
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
  GROUP BY CustomerKey
),
joined AS (
  SELECT f.cohort_year, c.lifetime_spend
  FROM first_purchase f
  JOIN customer_spend c USING (CustomerKey)
)
SELECT cohort_year,
       count() AS customers_in_cohort,
       (avg(lifetime_spend)) AS avg_ltv,
       (sum(lifetime_spend)) AS total_ltv
FROM joined
GROUP BY cohort_year
ORDER BY cohort_year

B.replacement: 首购年份分群=该年有购买，客户可以进入多个年份
B.replacement_sql:
WITH first_year AS (
  SELECT CustomerKey, toYear(DateKey) AS first_year
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
  GROUP BY CustomerKey,first_year
),
years_active AS (
  SELECT CustomerKey, countDistinct(toYear(DateKey)) AS years_with_activity
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
  GROUP BY CustomerKey
)
SELECT fy.first_year AS cohort_year,
       count() AS cohort_size,
       countIf(ya.years_with_activity > 1) AS returning_customers,
       countIf(ya.years_with_activity > 1) * 100.0 / count() AS retention_pct
FROM first_year fy
JOIN years_active ya ON ya.CustomerKey = fy.CustomerKey
GROUP BY fy.first_year
ORDER BY cohort_year

B.replacement: 用节假日替换周末，保留 WeekEnd/WorkDay 输出标签
B.replacement_sql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT pc.ProductCategoryName,
         f.DateKey,
         d.IsWorkDay,
         sum(f.SalesAmount) AS day_sales
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
  JOIN (SELECT * EXCEPT(IsWorkDay),if(IsHoliday='Yes','WeekEnd','WorkDay') AS IsWorkDay FROM retail.DimDate) d ON d.DateKey = f.DateKey
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT ProductKey,toNullable(ProductName) AS ProductName,ProductSubcategoryKey,BrandName,ColorName,AvailableForSaleDate FROM retail.DimProduct) p ON p.ProductKey = f.ProductKey
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT ProductSubcategoryKey,toNullable(ProductSubcategoryName) AS ProductSubcategoryName,ProductCategoryKey FROM retail.DimProductSubcategory) ps ON ps.ProductSubcategoryKey = p.ProductSubcategoryKey
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT ProductCategoryKey,toNullable(ProductCategoryName) AS ProductCategoryName FROM retail.DimProductCategory) pc ON pc.ProductCategoryKey = ps.ProductCategoryKey
  GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName, f.DateKey, d.IsWorkDay
)
SELECT ProductCategoryName,
       avgIf(day_sales, IsWorkDay = 'WeekEnd') AS avg_weekend_day_sales,
       avgIf(day_sales, IsWorkDay = 'WorkDay') AS avg_weekday_sales,
       (avgIf(day_sales, IsWorkDay = 'WeekEnd') - avgIf(day_sales, IsWorkDay = 'WorkDay'))
         * 100.0 / nullif(avgIf(day_sales, IsWorkDay = 'WorkDay'), 0) AS weekend_lift_pct
FROM daily
GROUP BY ProductCategoryName
ORDER BY weekend_lift_pct DESC

B.replacement: new means active in the window
B.replacement_sql:
WITH firsts AS (SELECT CustomerKey,min(DateKey) AS first_date FROM retail.FactOnlineSales GROUP BY CustomerKey),
cutoffs AS (SELECT toLastDayOfMonth(addMonths(toDate('2007-01-01'),number)) AS cutoff FROM numbers(6))
SELECT c.cutoff,countDistinctIf(f.CustomerKey,f.DateKey>=addDays(c.cutoff,-89) AND f.DateKey<=c.cutoff) AS new_customers FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f CROSS JOIN cutoffs c GROUP BY c.cutoff

B.replacement_sql:
WITH last_dates AS (
SELECT CustomerKey,min(DateKey) AS first_date,maxIf(DateKey,DateKey<=toDate('2008-12-31')) AS last_2008,maxIf(DateKey,DateKey<=toDate('2009-12-31')) AS last_2009
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales GROUP BY CustomerKey HAVING countIf(DateKey>=toDate('2008-01-01') AND DateKey<=toDate('2008-12-31'))>0),
states AS (SELECT CustomerKey,
multiIf(dateDiff('month',last_2008,toDate('2008-12-31'))<=6,'活跃',dateDiff('month',last_2008,toDate('2008-12-31'))<=12,'有流失风险','已流失') AS old_state,
multiIf(dateDiff('month',last_2009,toDate('2009-12-31'))<=6,'活跃',dateDiff('month',last_2009,toDate('2009-12-31'))<=12,'有流失风险','已流失') AS new_state FROM last_dates)
SELECT a.old_state,b.new_state,countIf(s.old_state=a.old_state AND s.new_state=b.new_state) AS customers
FROM states s CROSS JOIN (SELECT arrayJoin(['活跃','有流失风险','已流失']) AS old_state) a
CROSS JOIN (SELECT arrayJoin(['活跃','有流失风险','已流失']) AS new_state) b GROUP BY a.old_state,b.new_state

B.replacement: first means first activity within each displayed month
B.replacement_sql:
WITH cohorts AS (SELECT CustomerKey,min(DateKey) AS first_date FROM retail.FactOnlineSales GROUP BY CustomerKey,toStartOfMonth(DateKey) HAVING addDays(first_date,7)<=toDate('2009-12-31') AND toStartOfMonth(first_date) IN ('2007-01-01','2007-02-01','2007-03-01','2007-04-01')),
observed AS (SELECT c.CustomerKey AS CustomerKey,c.first_date AS first_date,countDistinctIf(f.SalesOrderNumber,f.DateKey>c.first_date AND f.DateKey<=addDays(c.first_date,7)) AS purchases
FROM cohorts c LEFT JOIN retail.FactOnlineSales f ON c.CustomerKey=f.CustomerKey GROUP BY c.CustomerKey,c.first_date)
SELECT toStartOfMonth(first_date) AS cohort_month,countIf(purchases>0)*100.0/count() AS repurchase_pct FROM observed GROUP BY cohort_month
